description: This file defines a FastAPI router for product recommendations in an ecommerce backend. It sets up an endpoint to fetch recommended products based on a request payload, calling an external service for recommendations and returning the response formatted according to the RecommendResponse model.

classes.name: RecommendRequest
classes.description: Request model containing optional user_id, recent_product_ids, and max_results for product recommendation.

classes.name: RecommendResponse
classes.description: Response model containing a list of recommended items and a rationale string.

methods.name: get_recommendations(payload: RecommendRequest)
methods.description: API endpoint handler that processes a recommendation request, calls the recommendation service, and returns a formatted response.
